description: CEC published notice records in Chinese or available English summaries; at most 30 days. Falls back to Chinese when English is unavailable, without translation. Published records are not verified current rules. Official Chinese exchange notices take precedence.

days.description: Integer lookback of 1-30 calendar days, including today in Asia/Shanghai, e.g. 7; omitted = 7, with actual source coverage reported separately.

exchange.description: Exchange code: SHFE, INE, DCE, CZCE, GFEX, CFFEX, SGE, SSE, SZSE, BSE, HKEX, NB, SB, TWSE, KRX, JPX, SGX, BMD, LME, ICE, COMEX, CBOT, CME, NYSE, NYMEX, EUREX or OSE; case-insensitive (shfe becomes SHFE), or an FC product slug such as shfe-cu (lowercased), at most 40 characters; required unless marked optional, with results limited to published coverage. Omitted = all exchanges; CEC records are matched by exchange code, not product slug.

lang.description: Case-sensitive notice language: en for available English summaries or zh for Chinese originals, e.g. en; omitted = en, falling back to Chinese when an English summary is unavailable, without translation.

topic.description: Case-sensitive CEC topic from the enum, e.g. margin or margin-price-limits; margin/price_limit match margin-price-limits, position_limit matches trading-limits, fees matches fees-order-size and listing matches contract-listing; omitted = no topic filter (recent_rule_changes still returns rule topics only).

name: recent_notices
